frontier.hypothesis: The original body consumed the second parameter at a point our reconstruction does not, leaving hard reg $a1 live past the copy — the ONLY surviving explanation for `addu $a3,$a1,$zero`.
frontier.mechanism: s6 H22 proves both GCC 2.7.2 allocators process a copy's source death before the destination's birth, so (set pseudo (reg $a1)) can never be denied $a1 unless $a1 is live afterwards. Nothing in target's 39 instructions reads or writes $a1, so the second consumer is one we have mis-attributed, that folded away, or that belongs to a further consumed parameter whose own parm copy is an elided self-move (invisible in the output but occupying $a1 as an allocno — exactly what p3u/p4u demonstrate for $a2/$a3).
frontier.next_probe: Work out what the second parameter semantically IS: read the three call sites (func_80020DDC at 0x80020DF8, the 0x800210F4 site, and special_camera_check_pos_outside_ground_80036E34, which jals with $a2/$a3 still live from its own arg2/arg3) and the D_800A3830 / D_800A3860 tables the $a1 value comes from. Then search for a consumed-3rd/4th-parameter shape that keeps the extra value live WITHOUT emitting an instruction — p3u/p4u each paid a store, and target has no spare store.

frontier.hypothesis: Target's $t0 for the E62 address is reachable only by raising the simultaneous-live-value count at that allocation point to six.
frontier.mechanism: s6 H21 — find_reg takes the lowest unconflicted hard reg, so climbing from our $a2 (6) to target's $t0 (8) requires 2,3,4,5,6,7 all unavailable; with four consumed parameters the pointer allocno lands on exactly 8.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate which six values target's compile could have had live simultaneously inside only 39 emitted instructions (candidates: the E62 address, a0, the a1 value, sval, cam_val, ec_val, reloaded — our body never has more than three live at once because each store kills one). Look for an ordering that keeps five of them live without the early D_80101E70 re-read that s4 H15 proved semantically divergent.

frontier.hypothesis: candidate.c's two /* FAKE */ pointer aliases still carry NO layer-2 cheat-reviewer verdict after four sessions (s3, s4, s5, s6 were all constrained from spawning agents).
frontier.mechanism: pointer-alias-fake-exception is a sanctioned last-resort family requiring documented lever-exhaustion + a named GCC-pass mechanism + a /* FAKE */ annotation; candidate.c supplies all three and the exhaustion record is stronger again after s6's three kills (s5 q08/q09 additionally show the pe62 alias is worth exactly -1 and only in the both-sides-through-the-pointer shape).
